description_en: Modifies the status of a VPC firewall that protects traffic between network instances in a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) and a specified VPC
description_zh: 修改VPC边界防火墙（防护云企业网内的网络实例和指定VPC之间的互访流量）的开关状态
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw modify-vpc-firewall-cen-switch-status --vpc-firewall-id vfw-m5e7dbc4y0000 --firewall-switch open --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyVpcFirewallCenSwitchStatus

parameters.help_en:
The language of the request and response. Valid values:

zh (default): Chinese.

en: English
parameters.help_zh:
请求和接收消息的语言类型。取值：

zh（默认）：中文。

en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the VPC firewall.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345777.html operation to query the instance ID of the VPC firewall
parameters.help_zh:
VPC边界防火墙的实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/345777.html接口查询VPC边界防火墙的实例ID
parameters.name: vpc_firewall_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the VPC firewall. Valid values:

open: Enable.

close: Disable
parameters.help_zh:
设置VPC边界防火墙的开关状态。取值：

open：开启。

close：关闭
parameters.name: firewall_switch

parameters.help_en: The UID of the member account
parameters.help_zh: 当前阿里云账号的成员账号UID
parameters.name: member_uid
